product_one_liner.value: Quantum Metric provides enterprise teams with digital experience analytics and AI that reveal where customers struggle, quantify business impact, and help prioritize fixes across digital products.
product_one_liner.notes: The official homepage describes the customer experience and business-impact product; its platform pages describe digital experience analytics and Felix AI.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page describes customized enterprise plans and invites visitors to contact sales; prices are not listed.

named_customers.notes: All are shown as customer organizations on the official customer-stories page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists headquarters as Colorado Springs, CO; Finovate independently identifies Colorado Springs, Colorado.

founded_year.notes: The company story timeline and Finovate profile identify 2015 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index includes multiple engineering-oriented posts discussing how Felix Agentic was built and technical considerations behind its MCP server.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation provides resources and a FAQ/community but no public product documentation portal or help center; the reviewed public resources do not establish a multi-article docs site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers page lists Account Executive, Strategic Account Executive, Enterprise Account Executive, Solutions Engineer roles and a VP industry-leader role; none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Google Gemini (including Gemini Pro for Felix AI summarization)
model_provider.notes: Quantum Metric publicly identifies Google Gemini as the generative AI model foundation for Felix Agentic and Gemini Pro for Felix AI Summarization.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page explicitly names SOC 2 and HITRUST attestation and ISO/IEC 27001 certification. GDPR is also mentioned as a privacy standard, not included here as a certification.

last_funding.notes: The dated investor announcement specifies a $200 million Series B on January 7, 2021; Tracxn identifies it as the latest funding round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round identified by the funding profile is the Series B dated January 2021, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers board lists live Strategic Account Executive and Enterprise Account Executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: On July 16, 2026, Quantum Metric announced the next evolution of Felix Agentic and related product capabilities, within the six months before the run date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jake Canaan's profile reports that he became Chief Product Officer in January 2026, within the 12-month window ending November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The official integration page expressly names its Salesforce Service Cloud integration.
